slides.title: Golf kicks off the day
slides.body: TOUR Championship, FM Championship, British Masters, Ally Challenge, and LIV Golf start at 12:00 AM ET.

slides.title: Early soccer starts
slides.body: PSV, Feyenoord, Ajax, and more. Catch matches on ESPN+ from 6:15 AM ET through late morning.

slides.title: Premier League window
slides.body: Brighton-Chelsea, Brentford-Leeds, and Fulham-Sunderland at 9:00 AM ET on Peacock, USA Network, and Telemundo.

slides.title: More Europe on deck
slides.body: Scottish Premiership, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, and Primeira Liga keep the soccer slate moving all morning.

slides.title: Watch and follow
slides.body: Check your local listings, stream where available, and follow @any_and_all_sports for daily schedules.
